title: 404 Route Handling
definition: Handling 404s in Express is simple: you just add a normal middleware function at the very end of your routing rules, right BEFORE your global error handler. If a request makes it past all your valid routes without being matched or responded to, it must be a 404.

answers.question: When should you avoid using 404 Route Handling?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
